raglight.title: RAGLight — File Knowledge Bank & Provisioner
raglight.description: Connect to an existing RAGLight server (local or cloud) or auto-provision a managed local RAGLight instance to index folders on your machine for Aura.

raglight.guideTitle: How the file bank works (for any user)
raglight.guideStep1: 1. Pick a free local provider (Ollama) or a paid cloud provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral) below.
raglight.guideStep2: 2. Add only the folders you want Aura to know about (studies, projects, notes).
raglight.guideStep3: 3. Click Install & Provision (sets up an isolated Python environment on Windows/Linux/macOS) and then Index folders.

hindsight.title: Hindsight — Episodic Memory Brain & Maintenance
hindsight.description: Manages personal memories, evolving preferences (superseding outdated facts), and automatic daily consolidation. Cross-platform for Windows, macOS, and any Linux distro.
hindsight.enableDescription: Retains conversation/task milestones and injects relevant memories into Aura responses.
hindsight.autoBanksDescription: Aura autonomously creates isolated banks (work, studies, finance, hobbies) as needed.
hindsight.dailyMaintenanceDescription: Runs memory consolidation and SQLite optimization once per day in the background.
hindsight.testRecallPlaceholder: Query what Aura remembers about you...
hindsight.guideTitle: First-time setup guide (Windows, Linux, and macOS)
hindsight.guideBody: Even without Hindsight installed, Aura works out of the box using the built-in SQLite memory store. To enable the full Hindsight daemon with Mental Models & memory graphs: 1) Configure an AI model (local Ollama or online API key); 2) Click Install local Hindsight (isolated Python/uv inside your user data folder); 3) Click Start daemon.

agentsHub.title: Agent Architecture & Tool Registry
agentsHub.subtitle: Aura's 8 specialized agents, granular permission policies, and safety validation guardrails.
agentsHub.registryHint: Privileged or destructive tools never permit unsafe automatic allow overrides.
agentsHub.goalPlaceholder: Describe a multi-step goal (e.g., read docs, open site, and check logs)...

orchestrator.name: Orchestrator
orchestrator.responsibility: Interprets intent, builds execution graphs, and delegates to specialist agents.
orchestrator.safety: Sensitive actions emit approval proposals before execution.

memory_agent.name: Memory Agent
memory_agent.responsibility: Queries, retains, supersedes, and links Hindsight and SQLite memories.
memory_agent.safety: Deduplicated writes preserving audit trail for superseded facts.

research_agent.name: Research Agent
research_agent.responsibility: Searches LightRAG / RAGLight indexed documents, entities, and knowledge graphs.
research_agent.safety: Read-only across authorized folders and configured endpoints.

browser_agent.name: Browser Agent
browser_agent.responsibility: Prepares structured web navigation, DOM inspection, and browser automation.
browser_agent.safety: Always requires user approval before mutating external state or submitting forms.

computer_agent.name: Computer Agent
computer_agent.responsibility: Prepares desktop window control, screen context capture, and app actions.
computer_agent.safety: Privileged UI actions require explicit human confirmation.

system_agent.name: System Agent
system_agent.responsibility: Inspects authorized workspace files, local services, and guarded shell tasks.
system_agent.safety: Destructive or shell operations cannot bypass human approval.

context_manager.name: Context Manager
context_manager.responsibility: Tracks 7-layer token budget, deduplicates memory injection, and compresses turns.
context_manager.safety: Never deletes raw message history during compression.

tool_registry.name: Tool Registry
tool_registry.responsibility: Maintains canonical tool schemas, permissions, risk levels, and audit logs.
tool_registry.safety: Rejects unsafe auto-allow overrides on privileged or destructive tools.
